entry.title: [io.projectreactor.netty:reactor-netty] Reactor Netty HTTP Client Leaks Credentials On Protocol Downgrade Redirect
entry.content:
In specific scenarios involving HTTP redirects from a secure to an insecure endpoint, the Reactor Netty HTTP client may leak credentials. In order for this to happen, the HTTP client must have been explicitly configured to follow redirects.

Affected versions: Reactor Netty 1.0.0 through 1.0.51; 1.1.0 through 1.1.35; 1.2.0 through 1.2.17; 1.3.0 through 1.3.5.

References

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-41715
  • https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41715
  • https://github.com/reactor/reactor-netty/commit/e7ef551eead84ba465324531683fafa03ab96ee9
  • https://github.com/reactor/reactor-netty/releases/tag/v1.2.18

entry.title: [org.springframework.ldap:spring-ldap-core] Spring LDAP has Authentication Bypass with Empty Password
entry.content:
Spring LDAP's DirContextAuthenticationStrategy implementations do not reject a bind request where a non-empty username is paired with an empty or null password.

Affected versions: Spring LDAP 2.4.0 through 2.4.4; 3.2.0 through 3.2.17; 3.3.0 through 3.3.7; 4.0.0 through 4.0.3.

entry.title: [org.springframework.retry:spring-retry] Spring Retry has Cache Exhaustion in Stateful Retries that leads to Denial of Service
entry.content:
An attacker can craft a large number of unique requests that trigger a failure, exhausting the capacity of the application-wide stateful retry cache. Once the cache is full, it permanently rejects any further updates, causing all later stateful retries and circuit breakers in the application to fail.

Affected versions: Spring Retry 2.0.0 through 2.0.12; 1.3.0 through 1.3.4.

References

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-41710
  • https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41710
  • https://github.com/spring-attic/spring-retry/issues/505

  • https://github.com/spring-attic/spring-retry/releases/tag/v2.0.13
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2827-2mxx-j8pv

entry.title: [org.springframework:spring-websocket] Spring Framework Predictable Session ID in WebSocket Module
entry.content:
IDs for WebSocket sessions in the spring-websocket module are not cryptographically unpredictable, which may be possible to exploit in combination with inadequate authorization rules.

Affected versions: Spring Framework 7.0.0 through 7.0.7; 6.2.0 through 6.2.18; 6.1.0 through 6.1.27; 5.3.0 through 5.3.48.

entry.title: [org.springframework.hateoas:spring-hateoas] Spring HATEOAS heap exhaustion through unbounded internal caching
entry.content:
Spring HATEOAS maintains an unbounded static cache of StringLinkRelation instances keyed on attacker-supplied strings.

Affected versions: Spring HATEOAS 1.5.0 through 1.5.6; 2.3.0 through 2.3.4; 2.4.0 through 2.4.1; 2.5.0 through 2.5.2; 3.0.0 through 3.0.3.

entry.title: [org.springframework.hateoas:spring-hateoas] Spring HATEOAS Collection+JSON/UBER deserializers do not honor Jackson configuration
entry.content:
Spring HATEOAS's internal PropertyUtils.createObjectFromProperties method, used by the Collection+JSON and UBER media type deserializers, performs bean property binding via reflection without consulting Jackson access-control annotations.

Affected versions: Spring HATEOAS 1.5.0 through 1.5.6; 2.3.0 through 2.3.4; 2.4.0 through 2.4.1; 2.5.0 through 2.5.2; 3.0.0 through 3.0.3.
